ModMetaData.name: Equipment Manager
ModMetaData.author: LordKuper
ModMetaData.description:
Automatically assigns weapons, tools, and loadouts to your colonists based on configurable scoring rules.
KEY FEATURES: - Loadouts: define named equipment sets combining primary weapons, sidearms, and tools. Auto-assign loadouts to colonists by trait, skill level, passion, work capacity, or stat thresholds. - Weapon rules: score ranged and melee weapons by configurable stat weights and limits. The mod equips each colonist with the best available weapon per rule. - Tool rules: assign work-type tools automatically (e.g. a mining pick for Miners, a chef's knife for Cooks). Supports "one tool per work type", "best available", and "all available" equip modes. - Work-type scoring: configure per-work-type stat weights that drive tool scoring. - Sidearm support: assign sidearms alongside primary weapons using the same rule system (requires Simple Sidearms). - Combat Extended: optional integration — ammo count targets respected when CE is loaded.
REQUIRED MODS: - Harmony (brrainz.harmony) - Simple Sidearms (petetimessix.simplesidearms) - LordKuper.Common — required for RimWorld 1.6 (auto-resolved via modDependenciesByVersion)
OPTIONAL MODS: - Combat Extended — detected at runtime; no hard dependency
